watch.summary: The streamer notices his friend's shiny silver character avatar inexplicably has bright pink nipples and roasts him for it.

beats.what: Streamer looks at his friend's metallic chrome character.
Streamer asks why the chrome character has nipples.
Teammate denies it over voice chat saying they aren't nipples.
Streamer retorts 'Then why are they pink?' and bursts out laughing.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Why do you have nipples bro on your chrome body?
watch.why: The absurd visual of a silver metallic character model having bright pink nipples provides immediate hilarious imagery. The casual, natural voice chat banter elevates the observational joke into a great laugh.
